prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 18 Test 1 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The graph below gives information about the percentage of the population in four Asian countries living in cities from 1970 to 2020, with predictions for 2030 and 2040. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 18 Test 2 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The chart below shows the number of households in the US by their annual ’ income in 2007, 2011 and 2015. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 18 Test 3 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The diagram below shows the floor plan of a public library 20 years ago and how it looks now. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 18 Test 4 Task 1
